#Supplementary Table 3 : LMM RESULTS
# Display LMM results for PT parameters in function of age, sex, rank and the number trial performed.

```{r}
# Scaling to have appropriate estimates for the different factors
data_norm <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(
    mean_trial_number = scale(log(mean_trial_number)),
    mean_rank = scale(mean_rank)
  )

# Initiate models for PT parameters
h1 <- lmer(rho_g ~ age_category + sex + mean_rank + I(mean_rank^2) + mean_trial_number + (1|monkey), data = data_norm)
h2 <- lmer(rho_l ~ age_category + sex + mean_rank + I(mean_rank^2) + mean_trial_number + (1|monkey), data = data_norm)
h3 <- lmer(alpha_g ~ age_category + sex + mean_rank + I(mean_rank^2) + mean_trial_number + (1|monkey), data = data_norm)
h4 <- lmer(alpha_l ~ age_category + sex + mean_rank + I(mean_rank^2) + mean_trial_number + (1|monkey), data = data_norm)
h5 <- lmer(lambda_ ~ age_category + sex + mean_rank + I(mean_rank^2) + mean_trial_number + (1|monkey), data = data_norm)

# Display model results
tab_model(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5)
```
